Rule.name: LDAP ApacheDS - Set Account Status
Rule.Description:
Disables or enables an identity's LDAP ApacheDS account.
Disable: sets pwdAccountLockedTime = 000001010000Z (ApacheDS admin lock) Enable : removes pwdAccountLockedTime
Then updates the IIQ account (link) right away - accountStatus, IIQDisabled - so the Application Accounts tab shows the new state without waiting for the next LDAP aggregation.
Inputs: identityName (e.g. "1015"), action ("Disable" or "Enable"). Called by the "HR Lifecycle - Status Change Notification" workflow (Terminated -> Disable, Terminated -> Active -> Enable) and by "LDAP ApacheDS - Disable Terminated Users".
